name: Redneck

result.prompt:
Create an EPIC 5-second illustrated fighting-game super finisher, portrait 9:16. Bold hand-inked outlines, rich cel shading, dynamic comic-book perspective, exaggerated scale and explosive acceleration. Reference image defines the exact character identity, face, costume, colors and props, NOT the background or initial camera crop. Preserve the illustrated character; no live-action or 3D makeover. Make a complete miniature action scene with a surprising payoff and a charismatic ending, not an idle animation with particles.
CAMERA AND COMPOSITING: cinematic camera motion is encouraged: dramatic pullbacks to reveal impossible scale, depth travel and deliberate close-ups. Establish the complete character early and return to a clear hero composition. Keep face and anatomy correct; intentional close-up crops are fine, accidental chopped limbs in a wide shot are not. The unoccupied backing remains perfectly flat pure cyan #00FFFF in EVERY shot, including close-ups. No scenery, floor plane, opaque rectangular manga panel, background gradient, vignette or full-frame whiteout. Use foreground objects and perspective to communicate distance. Large impact stars and disconnected tapered speed strokes terminate naturally on cyan instead of connecting to image borders. Warm effect colors with ink edges; no cyan/turquoise glow that will disappear under chroma key. No crowns. Use character-specific effects and props; do not add a recurring golden-fist emblem or generic fist-shaped power effect.
TEXT: one exact move title, thick uppercase comic lettering, warm white-to-gold fill, chunky black outline and dark offset extrusion, angled forceful slam with brief overshoot and settle. Stable readable spelling, intelligently placed away from the face, no additional captions or words. A title arrival is an impact beat of its own.
SOUND: strong synchronized anticipation, accelerating whooshes, exaggerated action hits, one dominant payoff, and a short settling tail. No music, speech or narration.

Redneck — Fix It Yourself.
IDENTITY: exact adult man with brown mullet, short goatee and mischievous grin, red-and-white trucker cap, torn open red/black plaid shirt, white undershirt, weathered baggy blue jeans, heavy brown work boots, tool pouch and large steel adjustable wrench. Preserve existing costume markings as small physical details; do not invent additional badges or power symbols.
0–0.7s: complete character beside a sputtering exposed engine suspended on cyan, roughly his torso size. Three disconnected dirty charcoal smoke puffs cough from it. He narrows his eyes, seats the wrench on its central nut, and cracks a confident grin.
0.7–2.5s: one furious wrench turn triggers an outrageous EXPLODED MECHANICAL VIEW: camera rockets backward as pistons, gears and casing fly outward into a huge coherent spiral around him, thirty feet across. He stays at the center holding the original wrench, one continuous action. A second hard wrist turn reverses the spiral: all parts slam back together in clean sequential clacks into a towering gleaming hot-rod engine. Bright ivory starbursts at the assembly contacts, pure cyan clearly visible between separated parts. No building, garage or floor.
2.5–3.5s: he gives the final nut a tiny additional quarter-turn. The huge engine answers with one thunderous exhaust pulse that blasts the dirty smoke knots completely away, red plaid tails snapping in the air. Exact title FIX IT YOURSELF slams across the lower composition on that dominant mechanical BOOM, without covering his face. The engine is repaired and clean, not destroyed.
3.5–5s: camera whips back to his complete proud stance, wrench over shoulder and restored engine beside him. One spare bolt drops neatly into his free palm. He studies it, shrugs and pockets it, ending on his grin. SFX: initial sickly sputter, rapid metallic expansion and gear ratchets, cascading assembly CLACKS, one enormous engine ignition, title impact, little bolt clink. No music or voice. Choreograph for five seconds with distinct readable beats, not sped-up footage.
